pages.text: A reaction that gives out heat warms what flows out; one that takes heat in chills it. The faster the reactants are mixed, the further the outlet moves from 298 K: T = 298 K ± h·ṁ. Each product wants its outlet in a band. Heat released faster than the jacket can carry it away runs away.
$(thing)Set$(): Mixing rate.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Feed temperature: the outlet varies by ±2%·d of its shift.
$(thing)Limits$(): Runaway: heat released faster than removed (ammonium nitrate decomposes).$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Product follows the feed.
